# raff_templates (Data Source)

Lists OS templates available for VM creation. Mirrors the digitalocean_images data source pattern.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `category` (String) Filter by template category. One of: `os` (Linux/Windows OS templates), `marketplace` (pre-baked apps). To filter by OS family (e.g. Linux only), match on the `os_type` response field with a `for` expression — there is no API-level filter for that today.
- `region` (String) Filter by region.
- `vm_type` (String) Filter: standard, premium, windows or cost_optimized.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `templates` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `is_windows` (Boolean)
- `licence_min_vcpu` (Number) Windows templates: the fewest vCPU the licence is billed for (0 when not priced per vCPU).
- `licence_price_per_month` (Number) Windows templates: the smallest monthly price of Raff's Windows Server licence, for a server with licence_min_vcpu vCPU or fewer (0 when not on sale).
- `licence_price_per_vcpu_month` (Number) Windows templates: the licence's monthly price per vCPU of the server's plan; a server pays it times its vCPU, at least licence_min_vcpu (0 when not priced per vCPU).
- `min_cpu` (Number)
- `min_ram` (Number)
- `min_storage` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `os_type` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `version` (String)
